name: Kwek-kwek
description: Quail eggs coated in orange batter and deep-fried, commonly served with spiced vinegar or a sweet-savory dip.
tagline: Munting itlog ng pugo na binalot sa kulay kahel na batter.
subtitle: Street-food favorite

name: Tokneneng
description: A larger battered egg street snack, often served with vinegar-based dipping sauce.
tagline: Mas malaking battered egg snack na madalas makita sa mga street-food stall.
subtitle: Street-food favorite

name: Balut
description: A fertilized duck egg with a developing embryo, boiled and commonly eaten warm.
tagline: Pinakuluang fertilized duck egg na kinakain habang mainit; bahagi ng pagkaing-kalye sa Pilipinas.
subtitle: Traditional delicacy

name: Penoy
description: An unfertilized or less-developed duck egg sold boiled; its contents are more uniform than balut.
tagline: Pinakuluang itlog ng pato na walang nabuong embryo gaya ng balut.
subtitle: Traditional delicacy

name: Tortang talong
description: Grilled or boiled eggplant dipped in beaten egg and pan-fried until golden.
tagline: Talong na pinalambot, nilublob sa binating itlog, at pinirito sa kawali.
subtitle: Home-cooked classic

name: Tortang giniling
description: A savory Filipino omelet with ground meat and often aromatics or vegetables.
tagline: Omelet na may giniling na karne at mga pampalasa.
subtitle: Hearty ulam

name: Itlog na maalat
description: Salt-cured egg, commonly paired with tomatoes and served alongside rice or other dishes.
tagline: Itlog na inasinan at madalas ipares sa kamatis.
subtitle: Salty and savory

name: Egg Soup
ingredients: Chicken egg, chicken broth, garlic, onion, and pepper
description: A warm, comforting soup made by slowly stirring beaten eggs into hot broth to create soft egg ribbons.
tagline: Mainit at masarap na sabaw na may malalambot na hibla ng itlog.
subtitle: Warm and comforting

name: Nilagang itlog
description: Egg boiled in its shell until the white and yolk reach the preferred doneness.
tagline: Payak na itlog na pinakuluan hanggang sa gustong luto.
subtitle: Everyday staple

name: Itlog na may kamatis
description: A quick home-style dish of scrambled eggs cooked with ripe tomatoes and seasoning.
tagline: Madaling ulam na binating itlog na niluto kasama ng hinog na kamatis.
subtitle: Quick breakfast
